style: Stylized 3D animated-film environment in the look of a modern stylized Unreal Engine 5 game level: real-scale but slightly simplified chunky shapes, painterly PBR textures, bright warm cinematic lighting with soft volumetric light shafts, floating dust motes, soft bloom on light sources, gentle depth of field, saturated amber and ochre palette with teal accents, well exposed and not dark. Completely empty of people and characters. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names anywhere.

plates.P02_street_jet: Ground-level worm's-eye view from the asphalt of a quiet 1990s American suburban street in the morning: wet asphalt reflecting sunlight, parked boxy 1990s sedans, houses with lawns. A grey Harrier jump jet fighter flies low directly overhead, close to the camera, heat haze and a sun flare behind it. Vertical composition: the jet in the upper third, the street stretching to a vanishing point in the lower half.
plates.P04_school_jet: A 1990s American high school front lawn on a sunny afternoon: a red-brick school building with tall windows and a flagpole, a green grass lawn, loose sheets of blank paper blowing in the air, a grey Harrier jump jet fighter hovering low above the lawn with downwash flattening the grass, dust and heat shimmer under the jet. Camera at eye level on the lawn. Open grass in the lower-middle third.
plates.P06_kitchen: A 1990s American suburban kitchen at night: a round wooden kitchen table in the foreground lit by a single warm hanging pendant lamp, a blank notepad and a pencil on the table, patterned wallpaper, an avocado-green refrigerator, a wall clock, a dark window. Camera slightly above table height looking across the table, open space behind the table for a character to sit.
plates.P07_classroom: A 1990s American high school classroom in warm afternoon sunlight: a large completely blank dark-green chalkboard filling the upper middle of the frame with a wooden chalk tray, a teacher's wooden desk in front, rows of student desks, a globe, sun beams through blinds on the left. Camera at standing eye level facing the chalkboard, open floor in front of the board.
plates.P08_diner: Interior of a 1990s American roadside diner at golden hour: an empty red vinyl booth with a formica table in the foreground holding two coffee mugs and a napkin dispenser, chrome trim, a checkered floor, a counter with stools in the background, warm neon glow and sunset light through the windows. Camera at seated eye level looking into the booth from the aisle.
plates.P09_mailbox: A 1990s American street corner at dusk: a classic blue curbside mailbox, plain with no logos or lettering, standing on the sidewalk right of center, a street lamp just turning on, maple trees, houses with lit windows, a purple and orange sky. Camera at eye level on the sidewalk, open sidewalk space to the left of the mailbox.
plates.P10_hq_tower: Extreme low-angle shot looking up at a towering 1990s corporate headquarters skyscraper of blue glass and steel against a bright blue sky with dramatic clouds, sun glinting off the glass, plain flags on poles at the entrance plaza, manicured hedges. Vertical composition emphasising height.
plates.P11_exec_office: A huge 1990s corporate executive office: an enormous glossy mahogany desk in the middle-ground with a tall leather chair behind it, a green banker's lamp, a pen set and a letter opener on the desk, floor-to-ceiling windows behind showing a city skyline in afternoon sun, dark wood paneling, a potted plant. Camera at desk height facing the desk, open space behind the desk for a character.
plates.P12_porch: The front porch of a 1990s American suburban house on a bright morning: a woven doormat in front of a white front door with a brass mail slot, painted wooden porch boards, potted geraniums, a porch light, morning sun casting long soft shadows. Low camera near the floor looking at the doormat and door.
plates.P13_courthouse: Exterior of a monumental federal courthouse in Manhattan: grand granite steps leading up to tall neoclassical columns and a triangular pediment with no inscription, soft overcast daylight, pigeons on the steps, blurred yellow taxi cabs on the street in the foreground. Low camera at the bottom of the steps looking up.
plates.P14_courtroom: Interior of a wood-paneled American federal courtroom: the judge's elevated wooden bench centered in the upper middle with a high-backed leather chair, an American flag on a pole beside it, two empty counsel tables in the foreground, empty gallery benches, brass lamps, warm light through tall windows. Camera at eye level from the aisle facing the bench.
plates.P15_gavel: Macro close-up of a polished wooden judge's gavel resting on a round sound block on a glossy wooden bench, shallow depth of field, warm courtroom bokeh lights in the background, dramatic rim light. Vertical composition with the gavel in the center.
plates.P16_countertop: Top-down overhead view straight down onto a worn honey-colored wooden countertop at a 1990s post office: warm wood grain, a ballpoint pen on a small chain near the top edge, a few blank envelopes and stamps at the corners, soft warm overhead light. A large clear empty area in the center of the frame.
plates.P17_store: Exterior entrance of a big-box department store at night before a huge holiday sale: large automatic glass doors glowing bright from inside, rows of red shopping carts, velvet rope barriers, a wet parking lot reflecting the lights, a blank banner above the doors. Camera at eye level in the parking lot.
plates.P18_school_bus: Interior of an American yellow school bus seen from the aisle looking toward the front: the empty driver's seat and the large steering wheel, the wide windshield showing a sunny suburban road, the folding door lever, rows of green vinyl bench seats in the foreground, warm morning sun.
plates.P19_crt_tv: Close-up perfectly straight-on front view of a chunky 1990s beige CRT television set filling most of the frame, the glossy glass screen completely dark and blank, sitting on a wooden dresser, warm bedroom lamp light from the side, a VHS tape and a remote control beside it.
